excludedSources.reason: These are earlier OSRM routes beginning near 4700 Liberty Ave. Their geometry and cues do not describe the final 4900 Friendship Ave routes.

notes: All coordinates are WGS84 longitude, latitude. No screen coordinates or thumbnail coordinates are serialized.
geometry, distanceMeters, gainMeters, and elevationsMeters preserve the original BRouter response.
displayGeometry and displayDistanceMeters reproduce the final desktop presentation algorithm using the original geographic traces. Output is geographic before screen rounding.
Spur removal changes route lengths. snapshot retains the recorded mockup card values instead of mislabeling them as original router measurements.
Snapshot gain numbers came from the original BRouter filtered ascend. Elevation gain was not recalculated after spur removal.
Every trace used the trekking profile. mode is the recorded presentation mode and does not certify bicycle suitability.
Only G1 has a matching recorded reverse-geocoded cue sheet. Other routes leave turns empty and identify unavailable metadata.

provenance.creator: BRouter-1.7.11-beta
provenance.elevationSource: Third coordinate of each original BRouter geometry vertex
provenance.displayGeometryUse: Presentation-only fixture. Reproduces the desktop mockup spur removal and simplification, with geographic output before screen-coordinate rounding.

turnsSource.method: Recorded reverse geocoding of simplified G1 legs. Leg geometry uses the matching original trace vertices. Distances retain the cue script local metric approximation.
turnsSource.quality: Design preview cue sheet, not navigation guidance.
